# Plenish

> Plenish is a weekly meal prep tracking and nutrition app. It tracks your meal prep inventory, auto-generates personalized meal plans based on ingredient freshness and preferred meal times, and tracks calories, protein, carbs, fat, and fiber — daily and weekly. Designed for GLP-1 journeys, ADHD, and fitness goals.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://useplenish.com/): Overview of Plenish features and value proposition
- [FAQ](https://useplenish.com/faq/): Common questions about meal planning, nutrition tracking, AI estimates, and account setup
- [Release Notes](https://useplenish.com/release-notes/): Full changelog of shipped features and fixes

## Blog

- [Why Daily Nutrition Tracking Fails GLP-1 Users](https://useplenish.com/blog/glp1-daily-nutrition-tracking-doesnt-work/): How weekly tracking better fits GLP-1 appetite patterns
- [A Different Approach to Food Tracking for ADHD](https://useplenish.com/blog/adhd-food-tracking-noise-different-approach/): Why standard nutrition tracking apps create friction for people with ADHD and how Plenish reduces it
